tabs.content:
//***********************************************************************************************************
let ts_jetzt = toscalar(
    energy_latest
    | where endpoint == "signal" and ts <= now()
    | summarize max(ts));
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "signal" and ts == ts_jetzt
| summarize Ampel = toint(maxif(value, series_id == "signal")),
            EE_Anteil = round(maxif(value, series_id == "share"), 1)
    by ts
| project Ampel, EE_Anteil, Stand = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card

energy_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1d)
| summarize Letzter_Eingang = max(ingestion_time())
| project Minuten_ohne_Daten = datetime_diff("minute", now(), Letzter_Eingang),
          Letzter_Eingang = datetime_utc_to_local(Letzter_Eingang, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card

let morgen = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(now(), "Europe/Berlin")) + 1d;
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price"
| extend Zeit = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| where Zeit >= morgen and Zeit < morgen + 1d
| summarize Negative_Viertelstunden_morgen = countif(value < 0),
            Min_ct_kWh = round(min(value) / 10, 2)
| render card
tabs.title: Negative Preise morgen

tabs.content:
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price" and ts <= now()
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Preis_ct_kWh = round(value / 10, 2),
          Stand = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
tabs.title: Alert 6: Strompreis jetzt negativ

tabs.content:
let letzte = toscalar(Netzfrequenz() | summarize max(ts));
Netzfrequenz()
| where ts > letzte - 5m
| summarize Max_Abweichung_mHz = max(abs(abweichung_mhz)),
            Tiefster_Wert_Hz = round(min(hz), 3),
            Hoechster_Wert_Hz = round(max(hz), 3)
| extend Stand = datetime_utc_to_local(letzte, "Europe/Berlin")
| render card
